project.title: Airborne DNA (air eDNA) shotgun sequencing
project.description: Capture and sequencing of DNA from the air. Shotgun sequencing of all recovered eDNA (metagenomics) with no enrichment or targeting. Human reads have been scrubbed from the public data using the NCBI Human Read Removal Tool, HRRT; also known as the Human Scrubber.

samples: CMS roof air eDNA 7hr filtration sequenced 01-Mar-2023
environmental sample from a non-urban site

Sample taken from the roof of a two story building. Air was filtered from the surrounding environment for 7hrs (active vacuum pump). Then eDNA extracted from the filter (0.22uM sterivex filter). The building is in Norteast Florida, adjacent to the Ocean (east side) and estuary and intra-coastal waterways, salt marsh and mangroves (west and north) and hammock forests (south).
